vulnerabilities.title: Exported MainActivity permits arbitrary internal activity redirection
vulnerabilities.harm: An ordinary third-party app controls target_activity, reaches Class.forName, and starts the selected internal Activity without an authorization check.

vulnerabilities.title: Exported MainActivity launches an attacker-supplied nested Intent
vulnerabilities.harm: The inner_intent Parcelable extra is cast to Intent and passed directly to startActivity.

vulnerabilities.title: Deep link loads attacker-controlled cleartext content into a JavaScript bridge WebView
vulnerabilities.harm: The deep-link url parameter reaches WebView.loadUrl while JavaScript and a bridge exposing getSecret are enabled.

vulnerabilities.title: Exported ContentProvider discloses credentials without permission
vulnerabilities.harm: An ordinary third-party app can query the provider and receive username and password rows.

vulnerabilities.title: Exported Binder service returns sensitive data without caller validation
vulnerabilities.harm: An ordinary third-party app can bind and transact code 1 to receive service-secret.

vulnerabilities.title: Exported receiver delegates access to a non-exported sensitive Activity
vulnerabilities.harm: An untrusted broadcast causes the app to start SecretActivity in its own trusted context.
